parts.title: Write for a real decision
parts.body: Put the decision request first. Then give context, options, recommendation, economics, risk, assumptions, and the next checkpoint. Use a small table when options differ on cost, control, and reversibility. State what evidence would change your mind. A memo should let an executive disagree with the assumptions without guessing what they are.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Draft a vendor memo
parts.body: Compare buying an enterprise assistant, building on a model API, and waiting one quarter. Include a 12-month cost range, data exposure, time to pilot, and integration burden. Recommend one route for a limited scope and name the checkpoint that authorizes expansion.
parts.label: Apply
